_comment: A lock IS committed, so sca-lock-file-missing is silent, but it is cut off mid-file and does not parse. The dependency audit reads the installed tree out of the lock, so sca-lock-file-invalid reports it, anchored at the lock itself, and halts the review like its sibling. Whether a readable lock matches package.json is left to the package manager at the build. Decided offline, no fetch.
